policy: Complete source stack metadata, separate from named-item eligibility and native appearance support. Runtime throwing-family gate remains in place. Existing saved counts and initialization policy are not rewritten by this projection.
limits: Source spawnstack is retained losslessly; it is not assumed to be the initialization bound for stackable weapons. Source weapon/misc/quiver and quality/drop-override initialization differ and need their complete callers.
The supplemental older total-max helper caps base plus extra stack at511. This data projection does not by itself certify the modern upper-cap/extra-stack or initial-quantity pipeline.
